note.zh: 来源页将低分辨率／展示用图像标为CC0。此处采用其公开的600像素画廊图像，保留标尺与色标。

transformation.en: A museum-photographed detail, downloaded unchanged from the public gallery; no local cropping or retouching.
transformation.zh: 直接保存馆方公开画廊中的局部照片，未作本地裁剪或修饰。

alt.en: Ink calligraphy with crossings-out and additions, preserved with red collector seals and a photographic scale.
alt.zh: 墨书手稿中可见涂改和增补，旁有红色收藏印及拍摄标尺。

caption.en: Draft of a Requiem for My Nephew, Yan Zhenqing, 758. National Palace Museum, Taipei, 故書000060. Detail from the museum’s presentation image; the photographic scale is retained.
caption.zh: 颜真卿《祭侄文稿》，758年。台北故宫博物院藏，故书000060。采用馆方展示图像的局部，保留拍摄标尺。

items.creator: Yan Zhenqing

interpretation.en: A detail of a surviving written document, not an illustration of the battle. Later collection seals belong to the object’s subsequent history.
interpretation.zh: 这是一份存世文字文献的局部，并非战斗场景的图画。后加收藏印属于此物的后续流传历史。
